items: Formal support is null for prior-only estimates; raw lawful parameters are kept without calling them discovery.
An edge-threshold inconsistency invalidates edge and modulation support; beta-only inconsistency invalidates modulation support.
Public fit accepts arbitrary nonempty equal-N/equal-sigma batches; the Run2 runner enforces exactly three events and the registered 1/3 mean.
At most eight prepared observation batches are cached with full legal-input, fixed-constant and grid hashes. Copying prevents caller mutation. No amplitude history crosses parameter candidates.

The first _prepare_batch cache miss performs initial static screening and both-grid enumeration. The runner archives and independently counts these existing terms; it does not execute them twice. Enumeration is report-only.
Event-block memory elimination uses the global Z singular-value threshold and global RMS row scale, algebraically equivalent to the block-diagonal global projection.
Qualification A follows the frozen Run2 complete weak-form and numerical gates; no new Run1-specific reconstruction gate is introduced.
A successful new fit drops the unused legacy parent initializer, making the new checkpoint standalone. Unfitted legacy loading and initialization remain unchanged.
root_decision: Accept these implementation clarifications as protocol-consistent before any formal action; no additional samples, scientific gates or optimization budget.
